test_added: .sandcastle/parity_window.test.mts: scripts/verify-parity-off.sh refuses a missing issue (names -Dparity-off-issue), a CLOSED issue and an unresolvable one, accepts an OPEN issue by printing `── parity OFF (#141) ──` (all against a stubbed `gh`), and `zig build --help` declares -Dparity and -Dparity-off-issue.
concerns: The build wiring is untested: deleting the two `if (parity_off)` blocks in build.zig (omitting verify-parity.sh, setting SUDOKU_PARITY_OFF on run_tests/glue/verify_gate, the guard dependency) leaves .sandcastle/parity_window.test.mts 5/5 green and `zig build verify-run -Dparity=off -Dparity-off-issue=141` then runs scripts/verify-parity.sh (1 `✓ parity:` line) and exits 0, so nothing in the suite goes red when the omission itself is removed — only the guard and the flag declaration are pinned.

Tree restored to HEAD (git status clean).
